Participatory democracy platform for proposals, debates, petitions, and surveys.

**Agora** is a **Nextcloud app for participatory democracy**, inspired by [Decidim](https://decidim.org) and built on [Nextcloud Polls](https://github.com/nextcloud/polls). It enables communities and organizations to collaborate on **proposals, debates, petitions, and projects** in a transparent and structured way.
### ✨ Key Features - 💬 Comments and discussions - 👍 Supports (likes/upvotes) - 👍 Supports (likes/neutral/against) - 🧩 Custom inquiry families and types - 🧾 Multiple inquiry formats (proposals, debates, petitions, projects…) - 📂 Categorization and filtering by family or location - 🧱 Scalable architecture and modern UX - 🔒 Secure and private — all data stays on your Nextcloud server - 🔗 Integration with Forms, Polls, Deck, Collectives,... - 🏛 Collectives desgin UX - 🗣 Real debate features (structured replies, multi-thread discussions) - 📜 Project law reading with article-level comments and supports - 🧰 Template for different goal, democraty, university, company, custom
### 🧭 Coming Next - 🏛 Collectives → Submit group of inquiries to Polls application for consultation or referendum - 🧮 Quorums and workflow automation - 🧰 Better permission control and moderation tools
